scope: Stationary held-out sequences. Gate: the target placed in the ego lane (requested lateral 0, matched by actor ID, including round bends) at each pose; a 5 m bin passes with >=5 independent poses, all but max(1, 10%) of which reach >=90% recall and valid depth, confirmation <=150 ms and depth error <=1 m. Usable range is the lower edge of the last contiguous passing bin. All visible cars/persons (map props, side targets) are reported separately with every pose required to pass. Moving/occluded objects require further evidence.
